officialName: Request for Termination of Compulsory Licence
purpose: Request termination of a compulsory licence previously granted by the Controller, stating the applicant's standing (patentee or a person deriving title/interest), the grounds, and the documentary evidence.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries numbered instructions (1-5); right column carries the running application with inline blanks and superscript markers.

sections.title: Name, address and nationality of the applicant(s).
sections.description: Instruction 1: name, address and nationality of the applicant(s). The applicant is usually the patentee.

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single applicant, 'We' for multiple.

fields.label: Name, address and nationality of the applicant(s)
fields.helpText: Full name (family/principal name first), complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality.

validation.message: Enter the applicant's name, address and nationality.

sections.title: Compulsory Licence to be Terminated
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'hereby apply for the termination of the compulsory licence granted to ...... by the order of the Controller dated ...... under Patent No ...... dated ...... granted to ...... for which the patentee ......'

fields.text: hereby apply for the termination of the compulsory licence granted to

fields.label: Compulsory licensee (granted to)
fields.helpText: The party to whom the compulsory licence was granted (from the Controller's order).

fields.text: by the order of the Controller dated

fields.label: Controller's order date
fields.helpText: Date of the Controller's order granting the compulsory licence.

sections.title: Standing Declaration
sections.description: Choose the applicable declaration (strike out whichever is not applicable).

options.label: I/we declare that I am/We are the patentee for the above mentioned patent
I/we declare that I/we derive title/interest in the patent

validation.message: State at least one ground for termination.

fields.text: I/we declare that the facts and matters stated herein are true to the best of my/our knowledge, information and belief.
The details of documentary evidence in support of my/our interest and the grounds stated above are given below:

fields.label: Documentary evidence
fields.helpText: List each document relied upon, as printed items (a), (b), (c).

validation.message: List at least one document in support.

sections.title: Address for Service in India
sections.description: Instruction 3: complete address incl postal index number/code and state along with telephone and fax number(s).

fields.label: My/our address for service in India
fields.helpText: Must be an address in India. Include postal index no./code, state, and telephone and fax number(s).

validation.message: Enter an address for service in India.

sections.title: To be signed by the applicant(s) or by his authorized registered patent agent.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: Name of the natural person who has signed.

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the applicant's address or the office recorded on the patent.

attachments.label: Certified copies of the documentary evidence
attachments.note: Instruction 2: certified copies of the documents are to be enclosed in duplicate.

notes: Note. - For fee: See First Schedule.
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable (I/We, I am/We are, title/interest, the standing declaration alternatives).
Certified copies of the documents are to be enclosed in duplicate (instruction 2).

printedHeader.statute: THE PATENTS ACT, 1970 (39 of 1970) and THE PATENTS RULES, 2003
printedHeader.subject: REQUEST FOR TERMINATION OF COMPULSORY LICENCE
